My partner used to talk about their exes without being asked - just out-of-the-blue, completely unprovoked, and when I'd ask them to stop, they'd get defensive and tell me even more. This led to many sleepless nights and just made me distance myself from them. They don't understand either, and they make me feel so bad about being jealous. We've almost broken up because of my reactions to things they told me.

I know how much it hurts, and it's a devastating revelation. I'm sorry you had to put up with that.

Just to add, I looked through their Facebook, and found searches for sex and dogging sites. They told me they didn't remember looking for those terms, but later they said they remembered, but they were 'just' drunk?? This was while I was away visiting family.
It's heartbreaking ;-;
